exact_statement: For K>=0 and an n-bit Boolean seed h with d=H(h)-K*a(h)>0, any adaptive physical data-query tree on t>=1 disjoint copies, with no intermediate cross-seed affine mixing or phase multiplication, has E D_K(leaf)>=t*d-(d+K*n/2)*E T+(K/2)*E Q. Thus nonnegative complete optimized child reserve forces E T>=t*d/(d+K*n/2). The same conditional bound holds after resolving independent rare activation and gadget bits. Here T counts touched seed blocks, Q distinct queried data coordinates, a is the full affine/output-character minimum influence, and all original reaches and complete terminals are retained.
